2026.name: 252日变动持续性代理
2026.description: 比较累计价格变化的跨度和日常波动，描述变化是否容易积累。它只是一个单尺度估计，不能当成稳定的长期趋势定律。

rules.selection: Original same-expiry/weekly-visible-definition/previous-observable-anchor policy; upper1.75, lower0.5; NY14:29 exact BBO; original BAW and quality gates; no extrapolation

rules.execution: t+2 open;20 sessions;repeat trigger resets one position;missing does not trigger or cancel timer;no last-row forced exit
